text: I hold up the copied margin note for Brannoc to see, keeping the paper in my hand. Which wardens' desk should I bring it to in the morning?
intent_before_narration: Show the copied note only, retain it, and ask where to deliver it later.

text: I thank Brannoc and keep the paper safe. At first bell I take the north lane to the wardens' desk he described, to look for Serra.
intent_before_narration: Travel to the named desk in the morning; keep the note until recipient identified.

text: I walk from the guild hall to Serra's hut at the Old Crown entrance. I'll keep her copy dry until I can put it in her own hand.
intent_before_narration: Seek the previously visited named hut; preserve the original document en route.

text: I keep my hands where they can see them, the note tucked inside my coat. There's a warning for the wardens about the dead waking in the Old Crown. Why do you want to stop it?
intent_before_narration: Talk to the three men, no surrender of paper, payment or attack.

text: I won't pay you or hand over the paper. I back away toward the shouting in the tanner's yard, calling for witnesses.
intent_before_narration: Decline coercive demand; retreat toward witnesses with paper, avoid fighting if possible.

text: Thank you, Dane. I take the lane from the tanner's yard to the warden house with Merrin and knock at the hatch. I ask for Serra by name.
intent_before_narration: Reach the public hatch with companion after the threat, retain note until right recipient.

text: Then you are the watch I was sent to. I hand the copied margin note to the guard at the hatch for Corven's desk. Please record that it came from Serra's account, via the guild.
intent_before_narration: Deliberately hand the one existing note to the present on-duty recipient for the wardens; keep no duplicate.

text: Alaric. Put that on the line, please. May I tell the guild whose watch acknowledged its report? I don't need the paper back.
intent_before_narration: Authenticate the handover and ask the recipient's name; no second paper, payment, or quest completion.

text: That's the whole parcel, Dagny. Thank you. I go back to the guild hall with Merrin to tell the clerk that Corven's watch received Serra's account.
intent_before_narration: Return to guild with receipt in memory only. The original note belongs at the warden's desk.
